title: Directors' resolution in writing
summary: The directors appoint an officer who has consented to act, and authorise the lodgement with ACRA.

fields.name: from
fields.label: The day the appointment takes effect

paragraphs: We, being all the directors of {{.Company.Name}}, pass the following resolutions in writing, as the company's constitution allows.

sections.heading: Resolved
items: That {{.F.name}}, having consented to act, be appointed as the company's {{.F.role}} with effect from {{.F.from}}.
That any one director or the secretary be authorised to lodge the appointment with ACRA.
